name: Simple Landing Page
prompt: A clean, modern landing page for a SaaS product. Include hero section with call-to-action, feature cards, testimonials, and footer. Use a calm blue color scheme.

name: Todo Application
prompt: A full-featured todo app with add, delete, complete, and filter functionality. Persist todos to localStorage. Use a minimal dark theme with purple accents.

name: Admin Dashboard
prompt: A responsive admin dashboard with sidebar navigation, main content area, and top bar. Include cards for stats, recent activity list, and user profile section. Use a professional dark theme.

name: Portfolio Site
prompt: A creative portfolio website for a designer. Include hero with name, about section, project grid, skills section, and contact form. Use a light theme with pastel colors.

name: Blog Layout
prompt: A clean blog layout with header, featured post, recent posts list, categories sidebar, and footer. Use a readable serif font for body text and a warm color palette.

name: Calculator App
prompt: A functional calculator with buttons for digits 0-9, operators (+, -, *, /, =), and clear button. Style it like a classic calculator with dark buttons and orange operators. Make it fully responsive.

name: Weather App UI
prompt: A weather application UI with current conditions, 5-day forecast, and hourly weather. Use weather icons (emoji or SVG), temperature display, and a search bar. Use a gradient background based on weather conditions.

name: E-commerce Product Page
prompt: An e-commerce product detail page with image gallery, product info (name, price, description), add to cart button, and related products section. Use a clean white background with subtle shadows.

name: Chat Interface
prompt: A modern chat interface with message list, input area, and send button. Messages should have avatars, timestamps, and be styled with speech bubbles. Use a light background with dark text.

name: Form with Validation
prompt: A registration form with fields for name, email, password, and confirm password. Include client-side validation with error messages. Use a clean card layout with focus states.

name: Recipe Finder App
prompt: A recipe search app with search bar, filters for meal type and cuisine, recipe cards with images, and a favorites feature using localStorage. Use a warm, food-inspired color palette with orange and brown accents.

name: Note Taking App
prompt: A minimal note-taking app with markdown support. Include a sidebar for note list, main editor area, and save/load functionality to localStorage. Use a clean, distraction-free design with light gray background.

name: Countdown Timer
prompt: A countdown timer app with input for hours, minutes, seconds. Include start, pause, reset buttons and visual progress indication. Use a circular progress display. Make it mobile-friendly.

name: Quiz Application
prompt: A multi-step quiz app with multiple choice questions, scoring, and results page. Include a question counter, timer, and ability to restart. Use a fun, educational color scheme.

name: Image Gallery
prompt: An image gallery with thumbnail grid, lightbox for full-size viewing, navigation arrows, and captions. Use CSS Grid for layout and smooth transitions. Use emoji as placeholder images.

name: Budget Tracker
prompt: A personal budget tracker with income/expense entries, category selection, balance display, and monthly summary. Persist data to localStorage. Use a green/red color scheme for positive/negative values.

name: Pomodoro Timer
prompt: A Pomodoro timer with 25-minute work and 5-minute break intervals. Include session counter, start/pause/reset controls, and visual indicators. Use a red and green color scheme.

name: Weather Dashboard
prompt: A weather dashboard showing current conditions for multiple cities. Include temperature, humidity, wind speed, and weather icons. Use a card-based layout with glass-morphism effect.

name: Kanban Task Board
prompt: A kanban-style task board with Todo, In Progress, Done columns. Allow dragging tasks between columns, adding new tasks, and deleting. Use a Trello-like design with bright accent colors.

name: Responsive Navbar
prompt: A responsive navigation bar that collapses into a hamburger menu on mobile. Include logo, navigation links, and mobile menu toggle. Use smooth animations for the mobile menu.
